title: Hidden Messages
text:
Social media platforms show us advertisements that seem to match our interests. These adverts are based on data collected from our searches, our likes and the pages we visit. Some people find this helpful, while others feel that their privacy is being invaded. Regardless of opinion, most users accept these terms without reading them carefully.

Influencers often promote products to their followers, and many audiences trust their recommendations. Nevertheless, a paid endorsement may not always be clearly marked. Therefore, viewers should ask whether a post is sponsored before they decide to buy. Since trust is valuable, honest labelling protects both the audience and the creator.

questions.text: According to the first paragraph, what are social media adverts based on?
options: Data collected from searches, likes and visited pages
Random selection by the platform's staff

questions.text: According to the second paragraph, what should viewers ask before they decide to buy?
options: Whether the product is sold in shops
Whether the video is longer than ten minutes

questions.text: Why might some users accept the terms without reading them carefully?
options: They may assume the terms are too long to be worth reading
They have already read them in a newspaper
They are required to read them by law

questions.text: What can be inferred about honest labelling?
options: It helps protect both the audience and the creator
It makes products cheaper for everyone
It is only useful for television advertisements
It is required only for famous influencers

vocabulary.definition: to publicise a product or service in order to encourage people to buy it
the right to keep personal information private
suggestions that someone gives about what is good or useful

paragraph_translations: Sosyal medya platformları, ilgi alanlarımıza uygun görünen reklamları bize gösterir. Bu reklamlar aramalarımızdan, beğenilerimizden ve ziyaret ettiğimiz sayfalardan toplanan verilere dayanır. Bazı insanlar bunu yararlı bulurken, diğerleri mahremiyetlerinin ihlal edildiğini düşünür. Görüşleri ne olursa olsun, çoğu kullanıcı bu koşulları dikkatlice okumadan kabul eder.

Etkileyiciler sık sık takipçilerine ürün tanıtır ve birçok izleyici onların tavsiyelerine güvenir. Buna rağmen ücretli bir destek her zaman açıkça belirtilmeyebilir. Bu nedenle izleyiciler, karar vermeden önce bir paylaşımın sponsorlu olup olmadığını sormalıdır. Güven değerli olduğundan, dürüst etiketleme hem izleyiciyi hem de içerik üreticisini korur.
